name: Bayesian Experimental Design
name_zh: 贝叶斯实验与观测设计
summary: Select measurements or experiments to maximize expected information or decision utility under uncertain parameters.
summary_zh: 通过期望效用或信息增益选择更有价值的观测位置、测量方案与实验设置。
core_idea: Optimize observation configurations using an expected Bayesian utility under prior and likelihood models.
innovation: Connects observation design directly to identifiability and expected reduction of parameter uncertainty.
limitations: Expected utility optimization may require expensive nested inference.
Design quality depends on simulator, prior and observation assumptions.

start_here.why: Foundational survey linking Bayesian decision theory to optimal measurement design.
start_here.focus: Expected utility criteria and nonlinear experimental design.

curation_note: Authoritative journal source checked; the proposed starting reference is optional.
